summary: Circumstantial evidence analysis; ballistic evidence connecting pistol; recovery based on co-accused disclosure; insufficient nexus to murder; absence of corroboration; three hypotheses test applied; conviction overturned due to incomplete chain excluding innocence; distinction between murder and evidence tampering; Section 27 Evidence Act inadmissibility of non-distinct facts; final acquittal.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction set aside; appellant acquitted of murder charges; bail bonds cancelled.
